mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5% month-over-month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL increases do not correlate with subsequent FEDFUNDS increases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2 percentage points month-over-month signals a tightening labor market, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or UNRATE decreases do not correlate with subsequent earnings growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over three months signals a strengthening demand in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator for economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 0.5% month-over-month signals increased economic activity, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO increases do not correlate with subsequent economic activity indicators.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 4%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or FEDFUNDS levels above 4% do not correlate with subsequent negative equity returns.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) increase by more than 1% month-over-month, it signals strong consumer demand, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or RSAFS increases do not correlate with subsequent economic growth indicators.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 month-over-month, it signals a robust labor market, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint condition does not correlate with subsequent economic strength.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is positive but below 2% quarter-over-quarter and housing starts (HOUST) increase by more than 5% month-over-month, it signals a mixed economic signal with potential for a market correction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth < 2% QoQ and HOUST increase > 5% MoM
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the joint condition does not correlate with subsequent market corrections.
